payload.reason: The evidence provides sufficient information about the performance of multilingual BERT (M-Bert) in various settings, including cross-lingual and cross-target tasks.

claims.text: M-Bert performs consistently better than majority class baselines in cross-lingual and cross-target settings, although it shows lower performance in zero-shot scenarios compared to supervised scores.
M-Bert has established itself as state of the art for various multilingual tasks and can outperform feature-based and other neural approaches in monolingual English settings.
M-Bert shows moderate success in zero-shot cross-lingual and cross-target transfer for stance detection, indicating its generalization capabilities.
M-Bert's performance improves when questions are presented in English, suggesting that language consistency can enhance cross-lingual performance.
